title: Answer questions of externally run relays from ork (needs slicer relay-run ask and answer)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Owner 2026-10-25. Relays run by an outer Claude session (started elsewhere) have no channel from ork back to the orchestrator. The owner wants a mailbox. adj 161 (relay.answer-channel) recommends slicer relay-run ask and relay-run answer in the shared ledger (ork uses slicer only through its CLI, goal C03; ork cannot write ../slicer). Draft slicer item: .scratch/slicer-relay-ask.md (the owner files it). This slice waits for slicer to ship it and for a relay contract version that tells an orchestrator to ask and poll; then ork adds that version to its accepted set.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/slicercli/types.go`, `slicercli.go`, `write.go`: the question on a step (list JSON) and a RelayAnswer write wrapper.
- `internal/daemon/*.go`, `internal/source/source.go`: carry the external question and the answer call.
- `internal/tui/pane.go`, `questions.go`, `overview.go`: the same option picker as the structured-questions slice for an external run; Enter answers via `slicer relay-run answer`.
- `internal/roles/roles.go` (accepted contracts) and docs.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - Not specified until slicer ships ask and answer: (1) a ledger step with a question shows an alert and the option picker for a started-elsewhere run; (2) answering calls slicer relay-run answer with the exact command shown on the confirm; (3) a contract version without the feature leaves the run read-only.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Blocked on the slicer item (.scratch/slicer-relay-ask.md) and adj 161. Write the spec after slicer ships it, reusing the structured-questions slice for the picker.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- slicer check
- adj lint
- Not runnable until slicer ships the feature.
